Enjoy an exquisite excerpt from the Raga Kalavati track on the Walking Together album (NRCD 0212).
This Hindustani/Carnatic instrumental duet features the mastery of Gaurav Mazumdar on Sitar and Jayanthi Kumaresh on Veena, accompanied by Debasish Mukherjee on Tabla and Satish Kumar on Mridangam. Immerse yourself in this fusion of two classical traditions.
